scope: Bounded local comparison of supplied One Bailey 101-102 bridge photos, plan, and review render

findings.bridge: Single continuous pale horizontal header with recessed central glazed/pergola volume.
findings.support_galleries: Courtyard-facing glazing is attached beneath/behind header and visually shorter than bridge mass; not two equal detached slabs.
findings.plan_orientation: 101 and 102 are distinct west-side footprints; plan establishes unequal frontage potential but not exact photo azimuth.
findings.current_mismatch: Current left support projects toward camera and both support strips read too tall; existing review cites about 15m frontage difference and over-tall 27.9m sill/support choice.

diagnosis.primary: wrong gallery/footprint face relationship and support proportions
diagnosis.secondary: camera perspective/mirroring affects apparent height and left-right ordering

astra_actions: Use courtyard-facing faces for 101 and 102, preserving their unequal frontage lengths.
Align the shared bridge header and central opening.
Shorten and recess support glazing beneath the header; keep it attached to tower/podium.
Retest negative-V orientation with 101 image-right and 102 image-left, then increase camera distance modestly.
